name: Plastic Bottle
description: A plastic container commonly used for drinking water and beverages.
recycle_details: Empty and rinse the bottle. Remove excess liquid and place it in the appropriate plastic recycling collection. Flattening the bottle can reduce storage space.
recommendation: Reuse the bottle when it is safe to do so. Otherwise, send it to a plastic recycling facility.
suggestion: Avoid throwing plastic bottles into general waste. Carry a reusable water bottle to reduce plastic consumption.

name: Cardboard
description: Paper-based packaging material commonly used for boxes and product packaging.
recycle_details: Keep cardboard clean and dry. Remove plastic wrapping, food contamination and excessive tape where practical before recycling.
recommendation: Flatten cardboard boxes and place them in dry-paper recycling.
suggestion: Reuse boxes for storage or packing before recycling them.

name: Food Waste
description: Organic waste generated from food preparation and leftover food.
recycle_details: Food scraps can generally be processed through composting or other approved organic-waste systems.
recommendation: Separate food waste from dry waste and use a suitable composting or organic-waste collection system.
suggestion: Reduce food waste by planning meals, storing food correctly and using leftovers.

name: Glass Bottle
description: A reusable or recyclable container made from glass.
recycle_details: Empty the bottle and rinse it. Keep glass separated according to your local collection system. Do not mix broken glass loosely with ordinary household waste.
recommendation: Reuse intact bottles where appropriate or take them to an approved glass-recycling collection point.
suggestion: Handle broken glass carefully and follow local disposal instructions.

name: Metal Can
description: Metal packaging commonly used for beverages and food products.
recycle_details: Empty and rinse the can before placing it into a suitable metal recycling collection.
recommendation: Recycle aluminium and steel cans through an approved recycling program.
suggestion: Avoid putting cans containing hazardous substances into ordinary recycling.

name: Electronic Waste
description: Discarded electronic equipment such as phones, computers, chargers and other electronic devices.
recycle_details: Electronic waste should be taken to an authorized e-waste collection or recycling facility. Batteries and certain components may require separate handling.
recommendation: Do not place electronic devices in ordinary household waste. Use an authorized e-waste recycler.
suggestion: Repair, donate or refurbish working electronics before recycling them.

name: Used Battery
description: A spent portable battery from an electronic device, toy or household product.
recycle_details: Do not place batteries in ordinary household waste. Use an approved battery or e-waste collection facility.
recommendation: Keep used batteries separate and take them to an authorized collection point.
suggestion: Prevent short circuits by handling damaged batteries carefully and following the collection facility's instructions.

name: Used Clothes
description: Clothing that is no longer wanted or suitable for regular use.
recycle_details: Clean and usable clothing can often be donated or reused. Damaged textiles may be accepted by specialized textile-recycling programs.
recommendation: Donate usable clothing before considering disposal.
suggestion: Repair damaged clothes or repurpose them as cleaning cloths where appropriate.

name: Paper
description: Common paper products such as office paper, newspapers and notebooks.
recycle_details: Keep paper clean and dry and separate it from food waste and other contamination.
recommendation: Place clean paper into an appropriate paper-recycling stream.
suggestion: Use both sides of paper when possible before recycling.

name: Organic Garden Waste
description: Leaves, grass clippings, small plant trimmings and other biodegradable garden material.
recycle_details: Garden waste can often be composted or processed through an approved green-waste collection system.
recommendation: Compost suitable garden waste or use a local green-waste collection service.
suggestion: Use composted organic material to improve soil instead of sending it to landfill.
